_comment: DEV VERSION - CloudFront Testing - DO NOT USE IN PRODUCTION
name: curseforge-serverpack-cloudfront-dev
author: olle.ljung@gmail.com
description: DEV EGG - Curseforge serverpacks with CloudFront testing

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Serverpack Installation Script - CloudFront DEV VERSION
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Install curl, python3, pip3 and java OpenJDK and configure Java
apt-get update -y
apt-get upgrade -y
mkdir -p /usr/share/man/man1 /usr/share/man/man2
apt -y install sudo curl python3 python3-pip rsync
sudo dpkg --configure -a

# Go to server folder
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

# Download DEV version of installer that supports CloudFront
curl -H "Authorization: token ${GH_PAT}" -o C-S-D.tar.gz -L "https://github.com/SecretSphinx/sgh-sp-installer-cloudfront-dev/archive/dev.tar.gz"
tar -zxvf C-S-D.tar.gz --strip-components=1
pip3 install -r requirements.txt

# Remove old modpack files if exists
rm -rf /mnt/server/libraries
rm -rf /mnt/server/mods
rm -rf /mnt/server/coremods
rm -rf /mnt/server/.fabric
rm -rf /mnt/server/user_jvm_args.txt
rm /mnt/server/server.jar

# Run modpack installer script with CloudFront support
echo "Using CloudFront DEV mode - Panel API: ${PANEL_API_URL}"
python3 run.py -provider curse -modpack-id ${MODPACK_ID} --modpack-version ${VERSION_ID} --clean-scripts --pterodactyl --use-cloudfront --panel-api-url "${PANEL_API_URL}"
rm C-S-D.tar.gz

# Move files from scripts modpack_folder to main dir for ptero to see it
rsync -a /mnt/server/modpack_folder/ /mnt/server/
rm -rf /mnt/server/modpack_folder

# Deletes files left from script
rm /mnt/server/*.py
rm /mnt/server/requirements.txt

# Create symlink to allow for new forge startup
cd /mnt/server
ln -sf libraries/net/minecraftforge/forge/*/unix_args.txt unix_args.txt

variables.name: Curseforge Modpack ID
variables.description:
The modpack project ID from CurseForge found on the modpack page.

(Ex. https://minecraft.curseforge.com/projects/sevtech-ages ID is 268208)

variables.name: Modpack Version
variables.description: Version of the modpack to use. Available versions can be found on the modpacks's page on CurseForge. Set to "latest" to pull the latest version.

variables.name: Server Jarfile
variables.description: Full name of JAR file to use to run the server. The download script will rename it to server.jar by default.

variables.name: JVM Startup Flags
variables.description:
JVM Startup flags to use for the server. For Modpacks we recommend using Aikars flags for optimum performance. They are enabled by default.

Details: https://aikar.co/2018/07/02/tuning-the-jvm-g1gc-garbage-collector-flags-for-minecraft/

variables.name: Panel API URL
variables.description: DEV: Panel API URL for CloudFront signed URLs

variables.name: GH PAT
variables.description: gh access token to download from SGP SP Installer repo
